question: Does genuine DLK1-directed ADCT-701 clinical development supply a materially new, independently useful premise for a reproducible native-EMC RNA comparison that resolves the already shelved R3 DLK1 hypothesis, rather than merely renaming that hypothesis?
scope: Source/value gate only. No new gene outputs, RNA matrices, culture values, target scans, subgroup rescue or raw-count streams.
prior_scientific_decision: R3 DLK1 broad appreciable expression question was measured and independently shelved. Reuse final owner/reviewer/lead decisions, all favorable and adverse observations and prior pending scopes. A new ADC premise alone is not a new EMC measurement or reopening condition.
exposure: DLK1 selected by lead after sequential R1-R9 candidate work, not a preregistered genome-wide discovery or independent validation. During obligatory prior-decision reuse, prior reports containing DLK1 values were visible. These historical outputs are not new values or blinded analyses; all new outputs remain unopened.
conditional_claim: RNA-only comparative evidence could nominate tissue assessment, with no accessible-protein, dependency, efficacy or therapeutic-window implication. There is no universal protein requirement.

conditional_measurement_plan_if_reopened.units: Native specimen/donor RNA; source library/biopsy and technical probes are not independent patients. Cultures distinct, preparation checks not donors.
conditional_measurement_plan_if_reopened.comparators: Before outcomes, require fixed source-matched malignant lineage comparators rather than arbitrary broad-cancer median; historical LGFMS/MFS/SFT tumor comparisons and reference-array controls kept assay-specific.
conditional_measurement_plan_if_reopened.thresholds: No new numerical threshold or narrower subset will be chosen to rescue failed R3 thresholds. Reopening first requires independent evidence resolving a consequential existing question. Any such new comparison requires dated exact effect statistic/uncertainty/control/defeat amendment and integrating-lead review before values.
conditional_measurement_plan_if_reopened.coverage: All13Hofvander/all6GSE24369/all10GSE4303/all12TempO and identifiable native EMC sources retain actual eligibility/pending status; no favorable specimen selection.
conditional_measurement_plan_if_reopened.uncertainty: Donor overlap, technical replication, tumor mixture, capture/probe/annotation/batch and isoform differences; no pooling incompatible units.
conditional_measurement_plan_if_reopened.strongest_alternatives: Published other-sarcoma/normal progenitor expression, heterogeneous bulk DLK1, source/protein discordance, selection multiplicity and clinical premise already known.
conditional_measurement_plan_if_reopened.disproof: Existing comparable question already evaluated/shelved with no new evidence addressing that decision; clinical development premise false/obsolete or no new meaningful RNA contribution; unsuitable/pending disease/measurement/identity cannot be replaced by invented negatives.

source_routes: First reconcile tracked R1-R9 and ten-baseline verified DLK1 records. Verify exact drug official trial/primary source through genuine public metadata; reuse matching cached originals and do not repeat unchanged failures. No broad numerical gene scan.
restrictions: Owned folder only; no denied FAP tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA review/formation content, private/login/bypass, spend/GPU/outreach/publication/PR. Root alone integrates/pushes. Daily NY UI ban and actual per-image clock apply; quiet API/file work only here.
stop: If existing R3 decision covers current RNA premise and no actual new source resolves reopening condition, preserve reuse and stop this route; not global exhaustion. If genuinely new consequential source appears, stop before gene outcomes and propose finite exact stage to lead.
